items.title: Migrate production SMS traffic to a short code with AWS End User Messaging
items.summary: Migrating production SMS traffic to a short code means carrying opt-out records, keyword configurations, and two-way messaging across originator types that carriers treat as independent senders. This post covers opt-out list migration, keyword handoff, carrier behavior, and a phased cutover with AWS End User Messaging SMS.
items.creator: Harshvardhan Chunawala
